source_facts: Names, relationships, events, infant and growing Achilles, original borrowed armor and new armor follow supplied source. Specific colors, hair, faces and architecture are adaptation choices.

characters.achilles: Golden short wavy hair, amber eyes, warm olive skin, clean shaven athletic young adult. Infant tiny golden curls ivory wrap; child ivory teal-edged tunic; adult same face. Plain tunic ivory teal edging. Original bronze armor navy cape before Patroclus death; new golden bronze armor teal cape and engraved world shield only after chapter 7.
characters.thetis: Long wavy dark teal hair, sea-green eyes, turquoise dress, pearl hair clasp.
characters.peleus: Older king dark brown hair graying at temples, short beard, burgundy mantle gold circlet.
characters.patroclus: Short curly dark brown hair, brown eyes, warm olive skin, athletic kind young man. Blue tunic. Borrowed ORIGINAL bronze armor navy cape in chapter 5, never golden hair.
characters.agamemnon: Stocky middle-aged black-haired king, thick square beard, burgundy cape bronze circlet.
characters.hector: Tall athletic auburn swept-back hair short auburn beard, bronze armor rust-red cape.
characters.paris: Slim straight black chin-length hair, violet tunic, wooden bow.
characters.hephaestus: Stocky copper-red bearded artisan, leather apron, hammer.
